description: This Java source file defines a singleton class `ThingEventMappingStrategies` that manages and provides mapping strategies for various 'thing event' types within the Eclipse Ditto project. It maps different event type identifiers to functions that convert adaptables into specific event instances, facilitating serialization/deserialization of event signals.

classes.name: ThingEventMappingStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class that encapsulates the mapping strategies from string event types to functions that produce event instances from adaptable objects. It centralizes the setup of mappings for different event categories such as top-level events, ACL events, attribute events, etc., to facilitate flexible serialization/deserialization within the Ditto framework.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns the complete mapping of event type strings to corresponding JsonifiableMapper functions.

methods.name: addTopLevelEvents
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for top-level events like ThingCreated, ThingModified, and ThingDeleted.

methods.name: addPolicyIdEvents
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for PolicyIdCreated and PolicyIdModified events.

methods.name: addFeaturePropertyEvents
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for feature property related events like FeaturePropertiesCreated, Modified, Deleted and individual FeaturePropertyCreated, Modified, Deleted.

methods.name: addFeatureDefinitionEvents
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for feature definition events.

methods.name: addFeatureEvents
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for feature related events, including creation, modification, and deletion of features.

methods.name: addDefinitionEvents
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for thing definition events.

methods.name: addAttributeEvents
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for attribute events, such as creation, modification, and deletion.

methods.name: addAclEvents
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for ACL-related events such as AclModified, AclEntryCreated, Modified, and Deleted.

methods.name: revisionFrom
methods.description: Extracts and returns the revision number from the adaptable's payload, throws if missing.

methods.name: timestampFrom
methods.description: Extracts and returns the timestamp (Instant) from the adaptable's payload if present.

methods.name: metadataFrom
methods.description: Extracts and returns the Metadata object from the adaptable's payload if present.
